# Currents (`flowLines`)

Thousands of luminous streamlines drifting in deep space.

- Type: scene (draws its own image; put it first)
- Reacts to: nothing outside itself (pure motion)
- Cost: medium (~5.9 ms/frame at 5K on a Pro GPU)
- Built-in styles: Currents, Solar Wind

## Params

| key | label | kind | range / options | default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `speed` | Speed | slider | 0 … 2 | 0.6 |
| `density` | Density | slider | 0.3 … 2 | 1 |
| `depth` | Depth of Field | slider | 0 … 1.5 | 0.8 |
| `glow` | Glow | slider | 0 … 2 | 1 |
| `hue` | Hue Spread | slider | 0 … 1 | 0.35 |
| `pulse` | Pulses | slider | 0 … 1 | 0.6 |
